---
title: "Schedule"
---

Every day follows the same pattern. A **lecture** (about 1 hour), then a round of **pitches** where every team shows its plan in 2–3 minutes, then a **work block** on the project.

::: {.callout-note}
Colours: [lecture]{.block-lecture} · [pitch]{.block-pitch} · [work]{.block-work}
:::

## [{{< var day1 >}}](days/day-1.qmd) — full day

| Time | Block | |
|---|---|---|
| 09:00–09:15 | How this course works | projects, pitches, grading, AI policy |
| 09:15–10:15 | [**Lecture 1** — Compartment models]{.block-lecture} | SIR, $R_0$, herd immunity, equilibria, phase plane |
| 10:15–10:30 | Break | |
| 10:30–11:30 | [**Lecture 2** — When chance decides]{.block-lecture} | branching processes: epidemic takeoff *and* evolution of resistance |
| 11:30–12:00 | Project menu, form teams (3–5) | |
| 12:00–13:00 | Lunch | talk about ideas |
| 13:00–13:30 | [**Pitch 1 — The question**]{.block-pitch} | 2 min per team |
| 13:30–15:00 | [**Work block 1**]{.block-work} | T0, T1 and T2 as warm-up, then your project |
